events.title: ECB raises key rates by 25 basis points
events.summary: The deposit rate moves to 2.50%, effective September 16, as the ECB addresses persistent inflation.
events.detail: The Governing Council raised all three key rates by 25 basis points. Its new baseline projects 3.0% headline inflation for 2026. The meeting took place in Berlin.
events.why: Put crypto moves beside a major change in borrowing costs. A macro announcement can be relevant without proving that it caused an individual token's return.
events.timeBasis: Official ECB RSS pubDate: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:15:00 +0200 = 12:15 UTC.
events.locationBasis: Location of the September 10 Governing Council meeting
events.imageAlt: Governing Council members at the ECB meeting in Berlin on September 10, 2026
events.photoNote: Photographed at the Governing Council meeting and external press conference in Wannsee, Berlin, on September 10, 2026.
events.insight: Put crypto moves beside a major change in borrowing costs. A macro announcement can be relevant without proving that it caused an individual token's return.
events.watch: Compare subsequent inflation releases and official ECB guidance. A rate change can affect broad risk appetite without explaining every token move.
